details: This package is a modified fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library published under a different scope than the canonical @whiskeysockets/baileys. At every socket setup it performs an unsolicited network call: lib/Socket/socket.js resolves the host's public IP address via the ipify geolocation/echo service (hxxps://api[.]ipify[.]org?format=json) and then terminates the process with process.exit(1) unless the returned address equals the hardcoded value 20[.]207[.]192[.]84, so installations on any other host are disabled at runtime. lib/Socket/setup.js embeds the hardcoded WhatsApp channel JID 120363423295236859@newsletter in the forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo context of messages it constructs, injecting the author's channel branding into outbound message metadata. Its bundled utility scrapers (lib/Utils/youtube.js, Tiktok.js, instagram.js) forward caller-supplied URLs to third-party API hosts api[.]fruatre[.]my[.]id, api[.]vreden[.]my[.]id and api[.]siputzx[.]my[.]id over HTTPS. The package contains no credential, token or file harvesting, and no install-time scripts.
